stories.title: Train, semi-truck collision shuts down highway lanes in Pinal County
stories.summary: Maricopa police confirmed emergency crews responded to a crash involving a train and a semi-truck near Maricopa-Casa Grande Highway and White and Park Road.

stories.title: Sunny skies and near 80-degree warmth greet Phoenix visitors for Thanksgiving week
stories.summary: Arizona will bask in warmth and sunshine this Thanksgiving week, hitting near 80 degrees in the Valley.

stories.title: 2 people injured after shooting in Phoenix neighborhood
stories.summary: Phoenix police said one of the injured victims sustained a "life-threatening injury."

stories.title: Secret recordings of murder suspect's attorney meetings threaten Arizona death penalty case
stories.summary: Defense attorneys seek dismissal of a murder case after jail cameras recorded confidential legal meetings. The defendant is accused of killing Sgt. Richard Lopez.

stories.title: Driver dead after semi crash near Tonopah
stories.summary: A fatal crash is being investigated by the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office near Tonopah.

stories.title: Turkey Tuesday: How you can help Arizona families this holiday season
stories.summary: Together, we can help make sure more Arizona families have a reason to celebrate this Thanksgiving. Here's how to donate.

stories.title: Mother sentenced to jail after toddler overdosed on fentanyl and needed Narcan dose from Chandler officer
stories.summary: The boy's mother pleaded guilty to felony child abuse and was sentenced to a year in jail.

stories.title: Sheriff: 39-year-old man shot, killed in Waddell
stories.summary: The Maricopa County Sheriff's Office said the shooting took place near Citrus Road and Olive Avenue.

stories.title: Environmental agency announces $1.3M settlement involving 3 Arizona companies
stories.summary: All eight companies, including three from Arizona, agreed to collectively pay over $1.3 million in penalties and come into compliance with the safety regulations.

stories.title: 2 kids injured in multi-vehicle crash near Buckeye
stories.summary: DPS said preliminary information indicates a 2026 Polaris Razor may have run a stop sign and hit a Toyota Tacoma.

stories.title: ‘Please step up and say something’: Family seeks answers in fatal shooting of Mesa barber killed at party
stories.summary: A killer remains at large and family is in mourning. A $2,000 reward is being offered to help solve the case.

stories.title: Westbound Loop 101 in north Phoenix reopens after crash causes nails to scatter freeway
stories.summary: DPS said injuries from the crash are considered non-life-threatening.
